RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel in economics often reflects senior faculty demographics rather than deliberate discrimination, though it does increase the risk of unconscious bias. 

Public universities frequently have explicit diversity policies for selection committees. Check institutional recruitment guidelines or consult a faculty union representative to see if panel composition rules were violated. 

Raising gender bias directly without procedural evidence risks alienating colleagues in a close-knit field. Instead, follow up politely on your request for written feedback. If the explanation relies on subjective factors contrary to stated criteria, or if hiring protocols were breached, you can raise procedural concerns through human resources or an ombuds office rather than accusing the panel directly.
